title: 岩石循环与板块构造
topic: The Rock Cycle and Plate Tectonics

sentences.en: Today let's look at an idea every geologist returns to: the rock cycle, driven by movement deep inside the Earth.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来看每位地质学家都会回到的一个概念：由地球内部深处运动所驱动的岩石循环。

sentences.en: Every rock is made of one or more minerals, and each mineral has its own regular crystal structure.
sentences.zh: 每块岩石都由一种或多种矿物构成，而每种矿物都有自己规则的晶体结构。

sentences.en: Geologists sort all rocks into three great families: igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic.
sentences.zh: 地质学家把所有岩石归为三大家族：火成岩、沉积岩和变质岩。

sentences.en: Igneous rock forms when molten material cools and hardens; underground that material is magma, but once it erupts from a volcano it is called lava.
sentences.zh: 火成岩是熔融物质冷却硬化而成的；在地下这种物质叫岩浆，但一旦它从火山喷出，就被称作熔岩。

sentences.en: Cooling speed controls crystal size: granite cools slowly deep down and grows large crystals, while basalt cools fast at the surface and stays fine-grained.
sentences.zh: 冷却速度决定晶体大小：花岗岩在地下深处缓慢冷却，长出大颗晶体；而玄武岩在地表快速冷却，颗粒细小。

sentences.en: Sedimentary rock tells a different story: weathering breaks rock apart in place, erosion carries the particles away, and a river will deposit that sediment layer upon layer.
sentences.zh: 沉积岩讲的是另一个故事：风化就地把岩石破碎，侵蚀把颗粒搬走，而河流则把这些沉积物一层层堆积下来。

sentences.en: Over millions of years those buried layers are compressed into solid strata, and because the process is so gentle, it is almost the only rock holding a fossil.
sentences.zh: 历经数百万年，那些被掩埋的层层沉积物被压实成坚硬的地层；正因过程如此温和，它几乎是唯一能封存化石的岩石。

sentences.en: Metamorphic rock appears when an existing rock is subjected to enormous heat and pressure and reshaped without melting, turning limestone into marble.
sentences.zh: 变质岩则是在原有岩石承受巨大高温高压、未经熔化就被重塑时形成的，从而把石灰岩变成大理岩。

sentences.en: So what keeps the cycle turning? The Earth has a thin outer crust, a thick hot mantle, and a core, and heat from the core stirs slow currents in the mantle.
sentences.zh: 那么是什么让循环持续运转？地球有一层薄薄的外壳——地壳，其下是又厚又热的地幔，中心是地核；来自地核的热量在地幔中搅起缓慢的对流。

sentences.en: Those currents drag the crust along in enormous slabs we call tectonic plates.
sentences.zh: 这些对流拖动着地壳，形成一块块巨大的板体，我们称之为构造板块。

sentences.en: Where two plates grind past each other, stress builds up along a fault until it releases suddenly, and that seismic energy is felt as an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 在两个板块相互摩擦错动处，应力沿断层不断积累，直到突然释放，而这股地震能量就被我们感受为地震。

sentences.en: Where plates collide head-on, the crust is pushed upward, and this uplift is what raised the Himalayas to their great height.
sentences.zh: 在板块正面相撞处，地壳被向上顶起，正是这种抬升把喜马拉雅山脉推到了如此高度。

sentences.en: Once a mountain rises, erosion and even a slow glacier grind it back down, while the same movement can concentrate a rich deposit of metal ore in the rock.
sentences.zh: 山脉一旦隆起，侵蚀作用乃至缓慢的冰川便把它重新磨低，与此同时，同样的运动还能在岩石中富集起富含金属的矿石矿床。

sentences.en: So the formation of any single rock is just one stage in an endless loop, powered from below and reshaped above.
sentences.zh: 所以任何单块岩石的形成，只是一个无尽循环中的一个阶段——由下方驱动，在上方被重塑。
